WITH r AS (
  SELECT cr.campaign_id, right(regexp_replace(cr.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 8) AS tail, count(*) AS n,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.status = 'sent') AS sent_n
  FROM campaign_recipients cr GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) > 1
)
SELECT co.name AS empresa, c.name AS campanha, c.created_at::date AS criada, c.status,
       count(*) AS telefones_repetidos, sum(r.n - 1) AS linhas_a_mais,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.sent_n > 1) AS receberam_2x
FROM r JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = r.campaign_id JOIN companies co ON co.id = c.company_id
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 3 DESC
